company.name: Munjz
company.shortDescription: Munjz is a proptech solution that connects people looking for household services.
company.description:
Munjz is a proptech solution that connects people looking for household services with pre-screened professionals. The company's app provides integrated maintenance services required by each house and facility, as well as an online marketplace for home services, enabling clients to obtain maintenance services for homes, facilities, and businesses, as well as annual maintenance packages for plumbing, electrical, air-conditioning, cleaning, furniture assembly, CCTV, and other services.

Munjz was established in 2017 in Dammam, Ash Sharqiyah by Abdullah AlDaij.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,052,480 to $41,469,523, a 39.4x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 32 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
